t: AI Universal Translation: Cultural Context Adapter — Simple
name: AI Universal Translation: Cultural Context Adapter — Simple
title: AI Universal Translation: Cultural Context Adapter — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An adapter that keeps translation from committing cultural malpractice: it flags idioms, honorifics, taboos, and register mismatches, and routes them to human cultural reviewers. Literal translation is often wrong translation.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Risk update: prior 0.15, lik 0.8, marg 0.35 = 0.3429 posterior. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI-Powered Universal Translation & Cross-Cultural Communication + Building the Universal Language Translator
real_world_basis: Cultural adaptation review is standard in professional localization.
signature_version: Signature version: the language First/Last assessor — source intent (first) and received meaning (last) compared per high-risk exchange, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: build the risk taxonomy with cultural insiders, flag before publishing, and never auto-publish high-risk content.
math_note: Risk update: prior 0.15, lik 0.8, marg 0.35: 0.3429 posterior [verified]; Review-panel quorum for 7 insiders: 4 votes [verified]
safety: Respect safety: insiders define the risk taxonomy — outsiders don't get to decide what's offensive.
how_it_works: Translation output passes a cultural-risk classifier; flagged spans queue for human review with context notes. The demo recomputes the Bayes update for the risk classifier and the quorum for the review panel.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

[REAL ENGINEERING] An adapter that keeps translation from committing cultural malpractice: it flags idioms, honorifics, taboos, and register mismatches, and routes them to human cultural reviewers. Literal translation is often wrong translation.

Compounding view. Headline number: Risk update: prior 0.15, lik 0.8, marg 0.35 = 0.3429 posterior. This tier combines the mechanism with its limits: what is real engineering today, what the Signature version adds, and where the boundary sits.

real_world_basis: Cultural adaptation review is standard in professional localization.
signature_version: Signature version: the language First/Last assessor — source intent (first) and received meaning (last) compared per high-risk exchange, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: build the risk taxonomy with cultural insiders, flag before publishing, and never auto-publish high-risk content.

safety: Respect safety: insiders define the risk taxonomy — outsiders don't get to decide what's offensive.

standards: Full-file record, never a stub
